scope: SUITE dedicated Cloudflare anonymous preview, read-only smoke after actual Workers URL is confirmed

basis.note: The config declares an intended URL. It is not evidence that a Worker is deployed there.

prerequisites: GitHub main initial commit SHA received and checked against the public source to be built.
Cloudflare owner reports the actual Workers URL and successful deployment ID; verify the URL equals SUITE_ALLOWED_ORIGIN.
Use a fresh browser profile or isolated tab without personal/customer data; no RAW import, payment or account creation.

testsAfterURL.name: Top route and static shell
steps: Check HTTP status, document title, SUITE wordmark and bundled /app.js and /styles.css availability
testsAfterURL.expected: HTTP 200; title SUITE — Photograph workspace; SUITE Editor shell rather than ÉCLAT INTIME or a Cloudflare error page

testsAfterURL.name: Primary anonymous screens
steps: Open / and inspect Editor, empty photo preview, library, adjustment controls and photo strip without importing a file
Open /?view=author and verify author preview is visible without cloud submission
Open /?view=admin and verify it shows an administrator gate rather than an authenticated dashboard
testsAfterURL.expected: Editor has 写真を、意図した一枚に。 and empty-photo state; Author shows 作者ワークスペース; Admin displays SUITE 管理者 gate with no member or submission data

testsAfterURL.name: Anonymous session contract
steps: Inspect status and JSON fields without entering account data
testsAfterURL.expected: HTTP 200; mode SITES, principal null, anonymousLocal true, adminPasswordAuthenticated false, endedReason ADMIN_AUTH_NOT_CONFIGURED, signInURL null

testsAfterURL.name: Private Cloud routes fail closed
testsAfterURL.expected: Every route returns HTTP 503 with error ADMIN_AUTH_NOT_CONFIGURED; no asset, draft, member or submission data is returned

separateNotRunnableTest.name: Old signed cookie is refused after logout
stepsWhenFullEnvironmentExists: Issue an authentic SUITE session through Cloudflare Access on the dedicated full environment
Log out and preserve the former cookie only inside the authorized test client
separateNotRunnableTest.expectedWhenRunnable: HTTP 401 with error SESSION_INVALID and no principal
separateNotRunnableTest.reason: The preview has no D1 session ledger, Access assertion verification or signing secret. A fabricated cookie cannot prove revocation of a real issued session.
